name: Golden Bell Farm formerly Cedar Brae Berry Farm
tagline: Golden Bell Farm (formerly 'Cedar Brae Berry Farm')
description: Golden Bell Farm formerly Cedar Brae Berry Farm is a berry farm in Franklin, TN. Visitors come for Blueberries, best in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
